title: Round 1 sealed investigation:  complexity barriers to universal near-linear ECDLP
question: What are the precise theoretical barriers to a universal classical ECDLP algorithm in worst-case O(n log n) bit operations (n = total input length)? Examine the exact hypotheses of generic-group lower bounds, of known non-generic approaches, input-reading/arithmetic bit costs, and any conditional hardness implications; state precisely which assumptions a faster algorithm would have to escape.

claims: C1 (known upper bound): under multitape TM + affine Weierstrass encoding, [k]P is computable in O(n^2 log n) bit operations (O(b) group operations, each O(b log b)); no unconditional lower bound beyond Omega(n) is claimed; verification is NOT a proven barrier to solving.

C2 (proven on paper, elementary counting, not machine-checked, restricted model): straight-line group-operation programs of length L compute at most 4^L (L!)^2 points, so some Q in

needs L >= (1+o(1)) log2 r / (2 log2 log2 r) operations; computed table: r~2^256 -> L>=29.

C3 (known bound): Shoup/Maurer/Nechaev generic-group bounds give Omega(sqrt p) oracle calls (p largest prime factor of the group order); they do not apply to algorithms that use the coordinate encoding; escaping the generic model is necessary, not sufficient.
C4 (known bound, derived): Corrigan-Gibbs-Kogan S*T^2 = Omega~(eps*N) implies generic online time poly(n) needs exp(Omega(n)) advice.

C5 (known/heuristic): index calculus, Diem, Petit-Quisquater (heuristic, first fall degree doubted by Huang-Kosters-Yeo), MOV/FR, anomalous, GHS each apply to proper subclasses; best universal known is Theta(sqrt r) group operations.

C6: ECDLP solves CDH; converse partial (den Boer, Maurer-Wolf, Muzereau-Smart-Vercauteren; unverified); no known reduction between ECDLP and factoring; ECDLP decision version is in UP intersect coUP given group order (folklore).

C7 conjectures (mine, unproved): CJ-A scalar multiplication hardness; CJ-B no o(sqrt r) algorithm for prime-order prime-field curves with large embedding degree; CJ-C modular exponentiation not in NC.
L1 (Lean proposal, uncompiled): m*P = k*P iff m = k mod addOrderOf P; 172 finite sanity tests passed; L2 information bound r <= 2^L for injections Fin r -> bitstrings of length L.
No proof or algorithm for the target is claimed; proof_status unchanged.
next_action: PI: adversarially check C2 counting and the exact Shoup/CGK statements against full texts; compile Lean lemmas L1-L2; then settle CJ-A (exact cost of [k]P) by literature check and decide whether to record C4 consequence as a DEC.
